main: Gives 3 E.G.O resources of a random owned affinity on kill effectively refunding half the cost as a random affinity. Useful if you have a lot of {keyword:Gluttony}, {keyword:Pride}, and {keyword:Envy}, and want to convert them to another affinity and are fighting lots of trash mobs.

Threadspin V: It gets more damage, Atk Weight on Reson, and {st:GainSinStockAdder} application on allies. It also gives more resources and SP healing when targets are staggered or panicked. The corrosion gives an additional {st:GainSinStockAdder} to all allies when flipping tails. This makes her Awakening resource neutral or positive at 4+ Reson and her Corrosion when flipping tails.
Threadspin V: Hitting staggered or panicked enemies gives her {st:AttackUp}
